data.one_liner: Dart client library for the DeepL translation API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure‑Dart interface to DeepL's translation, document, glossary and writer endpoints. Handles authentication, request retries and response parsing. Supports text, document translation and rephrasing features.
use_when: You need programmatic access to DeepL's translation services from a Dart or Flutter app
You want to translate text or documents without building your own HTTP client
avoid_when: You require offline or on‑device translation
You need a UI‑focused translation widget library
strengths: Pure Dart, works on all platforms
Supports text, document, glossary and writer APIs
Configurable retries and custom server URLs
weaknesses: Requires a DeepL API key (paid beyond free quota)
Only works with DeepL, not a generic translation engine
No UI components, just API client
